title: sorghum schoenanthus
intro: Sorghum schoenanthus, commonly known as desert broom or sweet broom, is a plant species belonging to the grass family that is native to tropical and subtropical regions of Africa. The health benefits of Sorghum schoenanthus include its use in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum schoenanthus include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
